positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Built and launched a new product that automated skill creation for Alexa so everyone, even without
programming background, could create new Alexa skills with ease (blueprints.amazon.com). The product
was launched successfully to 11 marketplaces (US, CA, MX, AU, JP, UK, FR, IN, DE, IT, ES) and
allowed users to create more than two millions personal Alexa skills two years after the launch.
* Led a team of three engineers build a web-based tool for internal and 3P partner developers to develop
Alexa blueprints, templates for creating Alexa skills. Using the tool, more than 70 blueprints have been
created and launched in many different market places as mentioned above.
* Led the design and implementation of Blueprint API, a set of REST APIs for creating and managing
Alexa blueprint skills.

* Designed and developed software services that monitor the health of Amazon Elastic Cloud computers.
* Automated team dashboard generation using Ruby rather than wiki templates. Automated the build
process which cut down the time to launch services in new region from one week to two days.

patents.title: INTERACTIVE ANALYTICS PLATFORM WITH FOLLOW-UP COMMUNICATIONS  RESPONSIVE TO DATA INQUIRIES
patents.description: A computer-implemented method for initiating, on one or more computing devices, a follow-up communication to an energy user based on one or more interactions between a billing advisor user and a billing advisor interface to a utility bill associated with an energy user; identifying, on the one or more computing devices, content associated with the one or more interactions, the content identifying information responsive to a utility bill inquiry from the energy user; and providing, on the one or more computing devices, the follow-up communication with the identified content for transmission to the energy user.

patents.title: INTERACTIVE ANALYTICS PLATFORM FOR ENERGY PROGRAM DATA MANAGEMENT
patents.description: A system for creating energy program data that identifies promotional content of one or more utility energy programs associated with a utility service provider, and providing relevant promotional content items for display to a billing advisor user such that the billing advisor user can convey such promotional content items to a corresponding energy user.  In certain aspects, the subject system is configured with the energy program data in an offline process, and tailored for a requesting user in an online process.  As part of the offline process, the subject system analyzes the promotional content for metadata, and segments the promotional content into respective subset promotional content items based on the metadata.  Each of the subset promotional content items is mapped to a segment of target recipients so that the relevant promotional content may be conveyed to the appropriate recipient.  As part of the online process, the subject system receives a request for promotional content intended for a subject energy user from a requesting application.  To facilitate the request, the subject system obtains user information of the subject energy user, and determines whether the subject energy user belongs to one of the segments of target recipients.  Once the segment is identified, the subject system identifies the subset promotional content items that correspond to the identified segment.  In turn, the subject system provides the identified subset promotional content items to the requesting application.
